title: I won a small AI gamejam with this entry
author: kokutouchichi
selftext: Since we can now do a little self promotion, I won an Ai gamejam last year with this entry. I had bigger plans for it and wanted to do a bunch of stuff like clean up the UI and all kinds of stuff but it was only a gamejam game and I didn't have the time. Someday I'd like to go back and fix it or redo it, but in the meantime I think it's quite fun for what it is. I used a ton of Ai to pull this off. Convai.ai for the behaviors, eleven labs for some of the voices, meshy UI for some models, and all the code was done using 95% chatGPT. I think there is a lot of potential in games like this but no one has really hit the ball outta the park on a game that includes this functionality just yet.

comments.author: moneydollarz
comments.body: Hopefully I’m not too late but what gaming engine did you use to create this? Also did you use chatgpt 3 or 4?

replies.author: kokutouchichi
replies.body: I used unity and  comvai and I'm not sure which api they are using but it's probably 3.5 since it's so fast. Though I'm not sure exactly. You can build the backstory for all thr characters in comvai so thr LLM has something to generate from and reference. It's a really great system.
